source_refs.note: 9- Glyoxysomes: a main subheading of 3.4 Structure of the cell, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 74-75.

blocks.text: Glyoxysomes are similar to peroxisomes but are found only in plant cells. These organelles contain enzymes that convert lipids into carbohydrates. They are most abundant in the cells of lipid-rich seeds (e.g. castor beans and soyabeans). During germination, these organelles convert stored lipids into carbohydrates that provide energy for seed germination.
